# Standards & federation

Zaak Afhandel App declares the standards below in its manifest. OpenRegister publishes them to other servers without login, under `zaakafhandelapp.discovery` in `/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities`, so another instance can tell from a hostname alone whether it can connect. Tools such as [Nextcloud Peek](https://genhttp.dev/lambda/nextcloud-peek/) show it too.

## Standards this app provides

| Standard | Version | Access | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ZGW Zaken API (ZRC) resources](https://vng-realisatie.github.io/gemma-zaken/standaard/zaken/) | 1.5.1 | Nextcloud login | `/apps/zaakafhandelapp/api/zrc` (not published) |
| [ZGW Catalogi API (ZTC) zaaktypen](https://vng-realisatie.github.io/gemma-zaken/standaard/catalogi/) | 1.3.1 | Nextcloud login | `/apps/zaakafhandelapp/api/ztc` (not published) |
| [ZGW Documenten API (DRC) enkelvoudiginformatieobjecten](https://vng-realisatie.github.io/gemma-zaken/standaard/documenten/) | 1.5.0 | Nextcloud login | `/apps/zaakafhandelapp/api/drc` (not published) |
| [ZGW Besluiten API (BRC)](https://vng-realisatie.github.io/gemma-zaken/standaard/besluiten/) | 1.0.2 | Nextcloud login | `/apps/zaakafhandelapp/api/brc` (not published) |

## Standards this app uses

None.

## Federation (Open Cloud Mesh)

Zaak Afhandel App registers no Open Cloud Mesh resource type of its own. Objects it stores in OpenRegister can still be shared with another instance through OpenRegister's `openregister` resource type.

## How another server finds this

```bash
curl -s -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  'https://cloud.example.org/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities?format=json' \
  | jq '.ocs.data.capabilities["zaakafhandelapp"].discovery'
```

Paths are relative to the instance root. Prefix `/index.php` when the instance runs without pretty URLs (`core.mod-rewrite-working` is false). Endpoints that need a Nextcloud login are listed without their path.

## Administrators

- Stop publishing discovery for every app: `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_public --value=no`
- Hide only this app: add `zaakafhandelapp` to `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_hidden_apps --value=...` (comma separated)

Field reference and the shared list of standard ids: [Discovery and federation](https://github.com/ConductionNL/openregister/blob/development/docs/Technical/discovery-and-federation.md).
